script: Uranus spins on its side, tipped over by about 98 degrees. Scientists think a giant collision long ago knocked it over. One trip around the Sun takes Uranus 84 Earth years. So each of its poles gets about 42 years of sunlight in a row. Then it spends about 42 years in darkness. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
